Legacy flow uploads have a limited execution scope. In a supported legacy flow, the five required hooks replace their built-in formulas on each simulation step. Conditional and anchored wellbeing modes refuse uploaded wellbeing hooks. Optional demand-collapse, reputation, and Gini-damping hooks retain their defaults; changing them is refused. The anchor tests run the supported legacy hooks. Use Model Lab for general equation, stock, flow, solve-block, and overlay authoring.
